title: Explicit first launch, private remote APIs, and built-in guidance
summary: CloudlessOS 0.2.7-3 keeps fresh installations idle until the user chooses what to install, adds authenticated model and agent access through Tailscale, and introduces a permanent searchable guide for connecting external clients and understanding Cloudless concepts.
changes: Stop fresh Cloudless installations from downloading or starting a model automatically and ask the user to choose the default installation or manage models and recipes themselves.
Persist the first-launch choice safely across daemon restarts while preserving the existing startup behavior of upgraded Cloudless installations.
Add private Tailscale model and agent API routes with scoped Cloudless API keys, exact live endpoint URLs, explicit enablement, and independent dashboard and API Serve configuration.
Refresh Tailscale and API Access state after sign-in, key creation, key revocation, and network changes so controls and displayed addresses always match the daemon.
Keep Local network and Tailscale API controls unavailable until an API key exists, explain the requirement on hover and click, and default new keys to Model and agent access.
Add a permanent searchable Cloudless Guide with ELI5 sections for Hermes Desktop, models versus recipes, API keys, Tailscale, engines, containers, and connection troubleshooting.
Show live machine-specific URLs and model aliases in the Hermes Desktop guide and link its actions directly to API Access, Remote access, Model Manager, recipes, and engine settings.
Keep model and recipe selection manual after an unloaded or user-managed first launch and prevent stale engine state from reviving an unwanted default workload.
Document a verified one-command DGX Spark installation path while retaining detached installer signature verification and side-by-side installation instructions.
Add regression coverage for first-launch consent, gateway URL selection, scoped Tailscale exposure, remote-access refresh behavior, and the built-in guide.
